content_sections.heading: Katihar District Administration Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 1003 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download Katihar District Administration notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Minimum 10+2 (12th) pass; Proficient in reading and writing Hindi and English; Proficient in collecting data on mobile/computer Experience: Surveyors/volunteers who have done similar work before will be given priority in selection Age limit: 18 to 40 years Other conditions: Must already own an Android mobile phone with 4GB RAM, 64 GB internal storage, 5G/4G support and a good-quality camera Preference to candidates who have a two-wheeler Must give a declaration that the service is fully temporary and no other claim will be accepted Survey data must be entered in the Google Form in all columns of the department's format Desirable: Prior experience of similar survey work (priority in selection) Own two-wheeler (preference)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Daily payment equivalent to the amount fixed for skilled-category workers under the Bihar Minimum Wages Act. Purely temporary engagement on a daily basis for 26 working days in a month Target: survey of 500 beggars in Katihar district No remuneration and immediate cancellation of selection if survey is not completed on time or is incomplete Remuneration paid only after verification of Google Form entries

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Katihar District Administration Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill in the form and attach self-attested copies of your certificates. Send it to District Social Security Cell, Katihar, by by hand. Make sure it reaches by 26 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: The post fell vacant after the earlier temporary surveyor's selection was ended by memo no. 1002 dated 19.11.2026 General transgender persons and very poor communities living on footpaths or in slums are not covered by the survey Half-filled forms or columns will not be accepted under any circumstances

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Katihar District Administration Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Katihar District Administration Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Surveyor/Volunteer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Katihar District Administration Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to District Social Security Cell, Katihar, by by hand, to reach by 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Lump sum Rs. 14,066 daily-wage remuneration for a maximum of 26 working days, plus Rs. 349 mobile/internet allowance and up to Rs. 4000 travel allowance = Rs. 18,066 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Minimum 10+2 (12th) pass. Must be proficient in reading and writing Hindi and English, and in collecting data on a mobile or computer.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must already own an Android mobile phone with 4GB RAM, 64 GB internal storage, 5G/4G support and a good-quality camera. Preference to candidates who have a two-wheeler. Must give a declaration that the service is fully temporary and no other claim will be accepted. Survey data must be entered in the Google Form in all columns of the department's format.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary engagement on a daily basis for 26 working days in a month. Target: survey of 500 beggars in Katihar district. No remuneration and immediate cancellation of selection if survey is not completed on time or is incomplete.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Katihar district (public places in Municipal Corporation, Nagar Parishad and Nagar Panchayat areas).

faq.question: Q10. I applied under the earlier advertisement. What should I do?
faq.answer: The post fell vacant after the earlier temporary surveyor's selection was ended by memo no. 1002 dated 19.11.2026.
